objective: Navigate a 4-way stop intersection using the correct right-of-way rules.

missions.description: Come to a complete stop at the STOP sign.

trafficRule.title: Stop Sign
trafficRule.description: You must come to a complete stop before the stop line.

missions.description: Yield to the vehicle on the right or the vehicle that arrived first.

trafficRule.title: Right of Way
trafficRule.description: Yield to the car that arrived first, or the car on your right if you arrived at the same time.
